content: योगः [युज् भावादौ घञ् कुत्वम्] .²1 Joining, uniting. .²2 Union, junction, combination; उपरागान्ते शशिनः समुपगता रोहिणी योगम् <ls>Ś. 7. 22</ls>; गुणमहतां महते गुणाय योगः <ls>Ki. 10. 25</ls>; (वां) योगस्तडित्तोयदयोरिवास्तु <ls>R. 6. 65</ls>. .²3 Contact, touch, connection; तमङ्कमारोप्य शरीरयोगजैः सुखैर्निषिञ्चन्तमिवामृतं त्वचि <ls>R. 3. 26</ls>. .²4 Employment, application, use; एतैरुपाययोगैस्तु शक्यास्ताः परिरक्षितुम् <ls>Ms. 9. 10</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 86</ls>. .²5 Mode, manner, course, means; ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगेन कर्मणामुद्धरन् जटाः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 24. 17</ls>; कथायोगेन बुध्यते <ls>H. 1</ls> ‘In the course of conversation’. .²6 Consequence, result; (mostly at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> or in <ab>abl.</ab>); रक्षायोगादयमपि तपः प्रत्यहं संचिनोति <ls>Ś. 2. 15</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 55</ls>. .²7 A yoke. .²8 A conveyance, vehicle, carriage. .²9 .³({%a%}) An armour. .³({%b%}) Putting on armour. .²10 Fitness, propriety, suitableness. .²11 An occupation, a work, business. .²12 A trick, fraud, device; योगाधमनविक्रीतं योगदानप्रतिग्रहम् <ls>Ms. 8. 165</ls>. .²13 An expedient, plan, means in general. .²14 Endeavour, zeal, diligence, assiduity; ज्ञानमेकस्थमाचार्ये ज्ञानं योगश्च पाण्डवे <ls>Mb. 7. 188. 45</ls>; इन्द्रियाणां जये योगं समातिष्ठेद् दिवानिशम् <ls>Ms. 7. 44</ls>. .²15 Remedy, cure. .²16 A charm, spell, incantation, magic, magical art; तथाख्यातविधानं च योगः संचार एव च <ls>Mb. 12. 59. 48</ls>. .²17 Gaining, acquiring, acquisition; बलस्य योगाय बलप्रधानम् <ls>Rām. 2. 82. 30</ls>. .²18 The equipment of an army. .²19 Fixing, putting on, practice; सत्येन रक्ष्यते धर्मो विद्या योगेन रक्ष्यते <ls>Mb. 5. 34. 39</ls>. .²20 A side; an argument. .²21 An occasion, opportunity. .²22 Possibility, occurrence. .²23 Wealth, substance. .²24 A rule, precept. .²25 Dependence, relation, regular order or connection, dependence of one word upon another. .²26 Etymology or derivation of the meaning of a word. .²27 The etymological meaning of a word (<ab>opp.</ab> रूढि); अवयवशक्तिर्योगः. .²28 Deep and abstract meditation, concentration of the mind, contemplation of the Supreme Spirit, which in {%Yoga%} <ab>phil.</ab> is defined as चित्तवृत्तिनिरोध; स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते <ls>Bg. 5. 21</ls>; सती सती योगविसृष्टदेहा <ls>Ku. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>V. 1. 1</ls>; योगेनान्ते तनुत्यजाम् <ls>R. 1. 8</ls>. .²29 The system of philosophy established by Patañjali, which is considered to be the second division of the Sāṃkhya philosophy, but is practically reckoned as a separate system; एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति <ls>Bg. 5. 5</ls>. (The chief aim of the {%Yoga%} philosophy is to teach the means by which the human soul may be completely united with the Supreme Spirit and thus secure absolution; and deep abstract meditation is laid down as the chief means of securing this end, elaborate rules being given for the proper practice of such {%Yoga%} or concentration of mind.) .²30 A follower of the Yoga system of philosophy; जापकैस्तुल्यफलता योगानां नात्र संशयः <ls>Mb. 12. 200. 23</ls>. .²31 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) Addition. .²32 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) Conjunction, lucky conjunction. .²33 A combination of stars. .²34 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular astronomical division of time (27 such {%Yogas%} are usually enumerated). .²35 The principal star in a lunar mansion. .²36 Devotion, pious seeking after god. .²37 A spy, secret agent. .²38 A traitor, a violator of truth or confidence. .²39 An attack; योगमाज्ञापयामास शिवस्य विषयं प्रति <ls>Śiva B. 13. 7</ls>. .²40 Steady application; श्रुताद् हि प्रज्ञा, प्रज्ञया योगो योगादात्मवत्ता <ls>Kau. A. 1. 5</ls>; मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी <ls>Bg. 13. 10</ls>. .²41 Ability, power; एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः <ls>Bg. 10. 7</ls>; पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् <ls n="Bg.">11. 8</ls>. .²42 Equality, sameness; समत्वं योग उच्यते <ls>Bg. 2. 48</ls>.
